msg: The gnomes come in pairs always, such as Red and Yellow, Orange and Brown, Pink and Green or Purple or Blue. One half of the pair (Red, Orange, Green, Blue) will lead you to a light forest, the other half of the pair (yellow, brown, pink, purple) will lead you to a dark forest.Of the dark and light forests, one will have more mushrooms. This goes in phases, but i found that the light forest more consistently had more mushrooms - but sometimes the dark forest had a higher number so swap to this when needed. You need to work out which forest is having more mushrooms for that phase and try and click the gnome which corresponds to it.The rest of the features, e.g. beard or hat, do not matter and can be ignored. Colours are only important and what forest they correspond to.
